corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 5th-order (ኀምስ) loop on the right leg (ሄዱ, 'they went'), not 3rd-order ሂ.
Both visually on the page and grammatically in Amharic (ያስተማርከን, 'who taught us'), the first character is 4th-order ያ, not 1st-order የ.
The third character is 6th-order ብ (ተቀብለውት, gerundive 'having received him'), with the left-side notch clearly visible in the zoomed image.
In the canonical Ge'ez verb አመሕፅን (Luke 23:46), the character before ፅን is 6th-order ሕ as printed on the line.
Canonical Ge'ez reading of Luke 23:50 is ኄር ('good'), confirmed by the Amharic translation ቸር in L07 and the explicit back-reference ኄር ላለው in L29–30.
The printed glyph is 7th-order ዶ (ሄዶ, gerundive 'having gone to Pilate, he asked'), not 1st-order ደ.
The printed Ge'ez word is ዘውቅር (6th-order ር, 'which was hewn in stone', Luke 23:53), translated on the next page as በታነጸ መቃብርም.
